patch_description: Replace the exponentially weighted moving average with a two-stage approach: (1) a 1D constant-velocity Kalman filter with adaptive measurement noise estimated from local residual variance (noise-adaptive gain), and (2) a short zero-phase Savitzky-Golay pass to suppress residual slope reversals without adding lag (Savitzky-Golay with polyorder 2 preserves linear trends with no phase delay). The Kalman filter tracks the signal with minimal lag, its adaptive R reduces spurious reversals from noise spikes, and the SG polynomial fit preserves genuine dynamics. We keep the same output-length semantics (len(x) - window_size + 1) and the existing function signatures so `process_signal` and `run_signal_processing` remain unchanged. Moving-average baselines are kept as fallbacks for compatibility.
